title: PCP search_result (v1)
description: A single ranked match from pcp_search, carrying the origin classification that lets a reader trust-weight heterogeneous content.

origin.description: Authority classification. Stores that cannot classify a record MUST default to 'generated' — under-claim, never over-claim.

extensions.description: Namespaced custom fields (reverse-DNS or vendor prefix). Readers MUST preserve unknown keys.
